spotlight: Joined this trainer from Charlie Appleby (still with Godolphin) after she finished second in a 7f Kempton novice event under a penalty in December; started her time in France with a close second last month on first try over a mile on soft ground, so will at least have a race-fitness edge on some; tough task on the figures, however, and doesn't hold any big-race entries.

name: Anashkaya
comment: Won't lack for race-fitness but needs a step foward in form
spotlight: Hasn't done any racing above Listed level or on turf but been on the go since November, and won't lack for race-fitness; first win came over 1m1f 110yds on the AW in December, meaning trip is no issue, but is another in the field who needs market principals to under-perform to feature; represents a stable with a good recent record in this, though, and entered in the Pouliches and Prix de Diane.

name: Kendelya
comment: This looks a hard task on seasonal return for all that she can do better
spotlight: Won a mile conditions event at Clairefontaine in August (good to soft) on her third start, but was beaten 24l in a valuable C&D event (very soft) on only run after; more than capable of better but others far easier to like for the win; doesn't hold any big-race entries.

name: Ceramic
comment: Beautifully bred daughter of Lope De Vega, but owner has stronger claims with Green Spirit
spotlight: Beautifully bred daughter of Lope De Vega, who ran some sound races last year in Group company without winning one, but has a recent run under her belt, a 4l second in a mile Listed event at Saint-Cloud; unexposed at the trip but owner looks to have stronger claims with Green Spirit; entered in the Pouliches.

name: Green Spirit
comment: Lost unbeaten status in a C&D Group 1 last time; one to beat
spotlight: The highest rated of these for good reason, winning four of her five starts as a 2yo, including the C&D Prix d'Aumale from Narissa, before a second, again over C&D, in the Group 1 Prix Marcel Boussac; seems to handle most ground and Christopher Head won this race in 2023; entered in the Pouliches and Prix de Diane; one to beat.

name: Talmas
comment: Recorded a three-digit RPR when winning on the AW in December; has recent run under belt
spotlight: Recorded a three-digit RPR when winning a 7.5f Deauville AW conditions event in December, and ran respectably on his recent return to action at Chantilly over a mile, again on an artificial surface; not dismissed if just second start on turf sees him back to his best; entered in the Poulains and Prix du Jockey Club.

name: Dorzal
comment: Long odds when winning on debut, but held next time; possibly best fresh
spotlight: Bolted up as a 75-1 chance when landing a maiden for unraced colts and geldings in October (7.5f, very soft) at Saint-Cloud, but nowhere near that level in a Listed race after that over a bit shorter at the same venue; might be best fresh but a bit to find all the same; entered in the Poulains and Prix du Jockey Club.

name: Campacite
comment: Ran well in two Group 1s last season, one of those over a mile; place chances at least
spotlight: Progressed throughout juvenile campaign, which saw him land a mile Listed event at Deauville (good to soft) in August before two far bigger efforts in Group 1s, the last seeing him beaten just under 2l in the Criterium International (1m, very soft); sound place chances at least if trained on; entered in the Poulains and Prix du Jockey Club.

owner: Guy Pariente Holding G Augustin-Normand & Ecurie Friedrider

name: Komorebi
comment: Behind Nighttime last time; bred to be smart, so no surprise if he's improved over winter
spotlight: Enjoyed a consistent 2yo season, which included a couple of wins, one over a mile, but best effort looked to be when second to Nighttime in a 7f Group 3 here when last seen; bred to be smart, so it'll be no big surprise if he's improved for a winter off; seems to handle most ground and entered in the Poulains plus the Prix du Jockey Club.

name: Lyneham
comment: Unbeaten colt with lots of potential; Christophe Soumillon rides for first time
spotlight: Unbeaten son of Wootton Bassett, winning two mile races on soft ground last season; this is a much tougher assignment but he has a nice pedigree and is entered in the 2,000 Guineas, the Poulains and the Prix du Jockey Club; Christophe Soumillon rides for first time.
breeder: Scuderia Waldeck Snc Racing Club Bruno Bard Et Al
owner: Hollymount Stud France Sc Arthur Hoyeau Et Al

name: Regal Resolve
comment: Only runner to be supplemented; could be capable of plenty more
spotlight: Supplemented for this; held on debut  (behind Elastic) but then won twice when switched to the AW at Chantilly, the most recent a 1m1f Listed event in October under Colin Keane; interesting that leading connections have chosen to add him to this race; entered in the Poulains, Prix du Jockey Club and Grand Prix de Paris.

name: Elastic
comment: Has race-fitness on his side after recent win; owner also runs Nighttime
spotlight: Finished in front of Regal Resolve on debut and, like that rival, went on to win two races, the most recent of which was a Listed event on heavy at Saint-Cloud in March over a mile; clearly has above-average ability but owner also runs Nighttime, who had better form as a juvenile; entered in the Poulains and Prix du Jockey Club.

name: Nighttime
comment: Enjoyed a good 2yo season and step up in trip should suit; leading chance
spotlight: Followed a debut second with three wins, one of them over Komorebi here over 7f (soft ground), but ran easily his best race after that over the same C&D in the Group 1 Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere (Campacite fourth); yet to be tested at a mile but pedigree suggests it will suit; entered in the Poulains and Prix du Jockey Club.

name: Mirik
comment: Has won two of five starts and ran best race when second in Listed event last time; claims
spotlight: Has won two of five starts and turned in best effort when second to Saint Martin in Listed event over this trip on heavy ground on first run for nearly four months in March;  more exposed than that rival but should give another good account.
breeder: Haras De S A Aga Khan Scea

name: Space Waltz
comment: Debut turf winner who has run well in Listed/Group events on AW; claims back on grass
spotlight: Debut turf winner who has bettered that form on last two AW starts in Listed and Group company; likely to be suited by the step up to this trip and, although he needs to improve, this French Derby entry should play a role on reappearance.

name: Montsecret
comment: Useful form in three starts but he'll have to improve to win this on reappearance
spotlight: French Derby entry; has shown useful form in three starts and off the mark in conditions event at Compiegne in October; has something to find in this company on reappearance, though.
owner: Al Shaqab Racing Jean-Claude Seroul & G Augustin-Normand

name: Powai
comment: Steadily progressive juvenile who needs to improve but should appreciate this longer trip
spotlight: Well beaten on his debut run but has won both outings since; likely to appreciate the step up to this trip and, although he needs to improve, he gives trainer (who also has Space Waltz) a strong hand.

name: Saint Martin
comment: Turned in best effort to beat Mirik over 1m2f in Listed event last time; leading claims
spotlight: Has improved with every run and turned in best effort when beating Mirik on merit over this trip on heavy ground in a Listed event last time; another French Derby entry and he should give another good account.
owner: G Pariente Holding Le Marais Sas & Bernard Giraudon

name: Pearled Majesty
comment: Progressive sort who turned in his best effort when up to this trip last time; claims
spotlight: Progressive sort/French Derby entry who seemed to appreciate the step up to this trip when beating a reliable yardstick last time; no surprise to see him give another good account in an open event.
breeder: Newsells Park Stud & Fittocks Stud Ltd
owner: Mme Christiane Head & Mauricio Delcher Sanchez

name: Hardy Warrior
comment: Fourth in Saint-Cloud Group 1 in autumn; shaped as though retaining all ability last time
spotlight: French Guineas/Irish & French Derby entry; fourth to Puerto Rico in Group 1 at Saint-Cloud in October and shaped as though retaining all ability in three-runner conditions event on reappearance; shapes as though he'll be suited by the step up to this trip and he's the pick on figures.

name: Waybreaker
comment: Group 3 winning juvenile but needs to better form of stable debut/reappearance
spotlight: Group 3-winning juvenile but soundly beaten behind Saint Martin on first run for new stable last time; will have to fare better this time.

name: Zaramix
comment: Stepped up a fair way on debut form to win over this trip last time but more needed
spotlight: Stepped up a fair way on his debut effort to justify favouritism in 1m2f maiden at Saint-Cloud last month; French Derby entry will have to improve again to follow up in this company, though.
